headline: Millersville end Shepherd's unbeaten start on opening night
dek: Shepherd had not lost until Millersville came to town on opening night and left with a fourth win from five matches. Shippensburg, unbeaten themselves, beat Bloomsburg the same evening, and between them they hold every point the table has yet awarded.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Millersville have scored more than any other programme while conceding three goals in five matches, as few as any side has let in; the scoring and the meanest defence sit at the same end of the chart.

wire.line: Shippensburg are the last unbeaten side in the conference after Shepherd fell at home to Millersville on opening night.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: California (Pa.) have conceded thirteen goals, more than any other programme has let in, and have lost three of their five matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lock Haven have scored eight and conceded eleven without winning in four matches, and six different players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bloomsburg's eleven goals have come from eight different scorers, and both their defeats have come away from home.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Houck has made twenty saves for Shepherd and conceded four goals across their matches.

last_match.line: Shepherd's first defeat of the season; Millersville have won every match since losing at home to Ashland.

next_match.line: Shippensburg are the conference's last unbeaten side; West Chester have yet to win a match this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
